stem.text: Which statement about the halogens is correct?

A.text: Iodine cannot behave as an oxidising agent.

B.text: The volatility of the elements increases from chlorine to iodine because of the increase in molecular size down the group.

C.text: When an equimolar mixture of chlorine and hydrogen is exploded, only one product is formed.

D.text: When concentrated sulfuric acid is added to solid sodium bromide, hydrogen sulfide is one of the products.
